mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals a robust supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy in a strong labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, which historically correlates with increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a quarter and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2%, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines by >10% in 1 quarter and GDPC1 growth < 2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines by >10% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.
